name: Sleipner CO2 storage, Utsira Formation, Norwegian North Sea (Equinor)
description: about 1 Mt CO2/yr injected into a deep saline formation since 1996; more than 20 Mt stored; injection cost about USD 17/t (storage only); zero leakage detected across 28+ years of monitoring

sources.note: MIT Sleipner project page (USD 17/t injection, 15.5 Mt to 2015); ResearchGate review (over 20 Mt stored since 1996); read 2026-10-28
